findings.title: Hospital Bill Arithmetic Discrepancy
findings.detail: The subtotal and total payable on the hospital bill do not reconcile correctly with the itemized charges listed.

findings.title: ICU Stay Duration Mismatch
findings.detail: The hospital bill charges for 2 days of ICU, whereas the discharge summary states the patient was shifted to the ward on day 3 of admission.

quotes.quote: Shifted to the ward on day 3 of admission

findings.title: Pharmacy Invoice Date Outside Hospital Stay
findings.detail: The pharmacy invoice is dated 19 Oct 2024 from a pharmacy in Bengaluru, while the hospital admission was in Pune.

findings.title: Lab Reports Dated on Discharge Date
findings.detail: Multiple lab reports are dated 21 Oct 2024, the same date as discharge.

findings.title: Patient Name Consistent
findings.detail: No identity inconsistencies found across documents.
